revisions.name: host-file
revisions.reason: Review 20261127 MSVC CRT known routines (off by default, --known-routines=MASK / ?known-routines=MASK): threaded handler 396 (the retired Storm PKWARE slot) runs the static MSVC memcpy/memmove natively and writes EIP only to resume inside the same body after its first instruction (push ebp) on a decline, or falls through to the body RET; ordinary RET, no callback frame, invocation identity preserved. The host plumbs set_known_routines like set_delphi_fold. General callback ownership remains pending.
